Taco John’s Menu: Best Items to Try for Every Craving

Taco John’s has been a go-to spot for bold and flavorful Mexican-inspired food. With a wide selection of tacos, burritos, potato dishes, and more, there’s something for everyone. In this guide, we’ll break down the best items on Taco John’s menu, highlight pricing, and discuss options for delivery, catering, and special promotions. Whether you’re new to Taco John’s or a loyal customer, this article will provide detailed insights to satisfy every craving. If you enjoy discovering new Tex-Mex spots, you might also love this roundup of the best regional Mexican fast-food chains in America.

Taco John’s Burritos – Packed with Bold Flavors

Taco John’s burritos are a top choice for customers who enjoy a hearty meal wrapped in a soft tortilla. Known for their bold flavors and fresh ingredients, these burritos will satisfy your appetite any time of the day. Below are some of the standout options.

 Menu of Burritos

Burrito Description Price
Boss Burrito Filled with fan-favorite meats, pico de gallo, cheese, and bold spices $6.99
Scrambler Burrito Breakfast burrito with scrambled eggs, Potato Olés®, and choice of meat $4.49
Potato Burrito Potato Olés®, seasoned beef or chicken, nacho cheese, and fresh veggies $5.49
Breakfast Burrito Eggs, cheese, and meat, wrapped for a morning meal on the go $3.99
Scrambler Burrito Box (5) Box of 5 breakfast burritos for catering or large orders $12.99

Taco John’s Potato Olés® – A Fan-Favorite Side Dish

A must-try on the Taco John’s menu is their iconic Potato Olés®. These crispy, seasoned potato rounds are perfect on their own or as an addition to any meal. If you love potato dishes, the following options will be right up your alley.

Menu of Potato Olés®

Item Description Price
Potato Olés® (Small) Crispy, seasoned potato bites $2.99
Potato Olés® Scrambler Potato Olés® mixed with eggs, cheese, and choice of meat for breakfast $5.99
Potato Breakfast Burrito Potato Olés® wrapped in a burrito with scrambled eggs and cheese $4.99

Tacos – The Core of Taco John’s Menu

Tacos are the heart of Taco John’s menu, offering a variety of flavorful fillings with fresh ingredients wrapped in warm tortillas. From traditional options to modern twists, Taco John’s tacos never disappoint.

Menu of Tacos

Taco Description Price
Original Taco Beef or chicken with lettuce, cheese, and signature bold spices $1.99
Taco Salad Fresh lettuce, seasoned beef, cheese, pico de gallo, and taco spices $6.49
Softshell Taco Similar to the Original Taco but wrapped in a soft tortilla $2.29
Taco John’s Street Tacos Street-style tacos with choice of meat, pico de gallo, and lime $2.99 each

Taco John’s Breakfast Menu – Fuel Your Morning

Taco John’s offers a variety of breakfast items to kickstart your day. From breakfast burritos to the Potato Olés® Scrambler, their morning menu is packed with flavor and freshness.

Menu of Breakfast Items

Breakfast Item Description Price
Breakfast Burrito Scrambled eggs, cheese, and choice of sausage, bacon, or steak $3.99
Potato Breakfast Burrito Scrambled eggs, Potato Olés®, and cheese wrapped in a tortilla $4.99
Potato Olés® Scrambler Eggs, cheese, and Potato Olés® topped with your favorite meat $5.99
Mexican Donut Bites Lightly fried and sprinkled with cinnamon sugar $2.49

Taco John’s Meal Combos – Complete Meals for Every Occasion

Taco John’s meal combos are perfect for a full, satisfying experience. These combos pair your favorite tacos, burritos, or Potato Olés® with a drink and other sides, making it easy to enjoy a complete meal. For more on maximizing value, see these smart tips for getting the best fast-food combo deals.

Menu of Meal Combos

Combo Description Price
2 Original Tacos + Potato Olés® Combo 2 Original Tacos, small Potato Olés®, and a drink $5.99
Boss Burrito + Potato Olés® Combo Boss Burrito, small Potato Olés®, and a drink $7.99
Scrambler Burrito Combo Scrambler Burrito, Potato Olés®, and a drink $6.49
Taco Salad + Mexican Donut Bites Combo Taco Salad with a side of Mexican Donut Bites $7.49

Taco John’s Delivery Options – Convenience at Your Fingertips

Taco John’s offers a variety of options to enjoy their menu from the comfort of your home. Delivery, pickup, and catering orders can all be placed through their website or app, making it easier than ever to enjoy your favorite meals. With track your order features and options for 0 delivery fee on select services, Taco John’s delivery is quick, convenient, and reliable.

Menu Delivery and Fees

Delivery Option Details Fee
Online Ordering Place your order online through Taco John’s website or app Varies
Track Your Order Use the app or website to monitor the status of your order Free
0 Delivery Fee Special promotions may offer free delivery during certain hours or locations Free

Taco John’s Catering Menu – Perfect for Events

Taco John’s catering menu is ideal for larger groups or events, offering bulk options for tacos, burritos, and breakfast items. Whether you’re hosting a party, business meeting, or family gathering, Taco John’s catering can accommodate your needs with flexible menu items and generous portions. For event planners, this guide to catering from fast-food restaurants might be useful.

Catering Menu

Catering Item Description Price
Taco Bar (Feeds 10-12) Build-your-own taco station with beef, tortillas, lettuce, cheese, and toppings $49.99
Burrito Boxes (Feeds 12-15) A selection of burritos, including Boss Burrito and Scrambler Burritos $59.99
Breakfast Burrito Tray (Feeds 15) A tray of breakfast burritos perfect for early morning events $39.99

Special Promotions at Taco John’s – Deals You Don’t Want to Miss

Taco John’s often runs special promotions and limited-time offers that allow customers to enjoy their favorite items at discounted prices. These promotions change regularly, so be sure to check their website or app for the latest deals. If you love scoring deals, check out this list of the best ongoing fast-food deals and freebies.

Popular Promotions

Conclusion: Taco John’s Menu – A Flavorful Experience for Every Meal

From burritos and tacos to the iconic Potato Olés®, Taco John’s menu is packed with flavorful, bold, and satisfying options. Whether you’re dining in, ordering delivery, or catering for a group, Taco John’s has something for everyone. The extensive menu, reasonable pricing, and convenient delivery options make it easy to enjoy your favorite meals. Be sure to check out Taco John’s special promotions and limited-time offers to get the best deals on your next meal!
